title: feat(react-instantsearch): server-side rendering
body:
**Summary** This proposes a simple solution to support server-side rendering. The idea is to remove the need to do async actions from `` when rendering on the server side. Instead, we let the user fetch algolia results themselves, and inject them into `` through a new `resultsState` prop. Links to #1687, #1531, #1869 **Result** Here is a snippet from a server. `index` uses the bestbuy example: ```js function handleRender(req, res) { index.search('').then(state => { const html = renderToStaticMarkup( ) res.send(renderFullPage(html)) }) } ``` The rendered result is: ```html Server-side rendering example
